boundary: node-side relay command re-validation before root execution
attack_class: Relay command authorization and node-side root execution

local_checks.invariant: Node re-validates every terminal command after Noise decryption before root action; PTY bounded per owner
local_checks.result: HOLDS. PollV2 opens Noise envelope then runs validateTerminalRelayCommand (ID/SessionID hex, expiry within now..now+5min, four exact terminal paths, Rows<=500/Columns<=1000, input base64 bounded 16KiB). executeCommand requires DisallowUnknownFields decode; input/resize/close reject unknown session IDs — only locally-opened sessions addressable. manager.Open enforces bounds + MaxOwnerSessions=4. Expired/malformed fail tight. Blast radius on center compromise is full root shell by design (relay IS the terminal); input-level re-validation exists independently. Trust justified structurally (Noise IK, keys never leave node, peer-key change rejected ErrIdentityMismatch).

local_checks.invariant: File broker commands re-validated node-side; filesystem effects constrained by node's own filemanager policy
local_checks.result: HOLDS. Node-side PollV2 applies validateFileRelayCommand after decryption (exact path switch, no traversal, query <=48KiB no CRLF, BodyLength bounds, header hygiene, offset chaining). Requests dispatch into filemanager via agent.NewFileHandler serving only /v1/files* routes; resolveExisting rejects symlink components, enforces protected dirs including /etc/kejilion-node and /var/lib/kejilion-node (Noise keys unreachable), OpenRoot confinement. Stream transport re-validates, ContentLength=-1 forces authenticated EOF, streamMaxUpload + 2h lifetime. Malicious center touches only the intended admin file-manager surface with the same ceiling the full agent enforces.

local_checks.invariant: SSH-login broker only observes validated credential-free login events; reads no key material; executes no relay-supplied inputs
local_checks.result: HOLDS. --output validated absolute non-root; exclusively journalctl fixed args or tail on fixed auth logs; events must match acceptedPattern + loginToken/loginAddress regexes; WriteSSHLoginEvent rejects fields failing contract.ValidSSHLoginEvent, untrusted dirs; writes 0640 atomic under /run/kejilion-node-ssh 0750. Telemetry process re-validates on read (Lstat/SameFile/DisallowUnknownFields); center re-validates again. No SSH key material or sshd config touched; relay file contains only four credential-free fields.

local_checks.invariant: Node config and Noise key files root-owned, mode-restricted, symlink-immune, SameFile anti-TOCTOU on every read; failures hard refusals
local_checks.result: HOLDS. node.json: regular Lstat + SameFile + <=8KiB + strict JSON + HTTPS-only origin + 32-byte key + hex NodeID; atomic 0600 writes preserving installer ownership. terminal.json (Noise identity): mode&0077==0 required (0600 only) + SameFile. Legacy migration never follows symlinks; migrationTrustedExecutable fixed absolute candidates re-validated. /etc/kejilion-node kept 0750 root:gid; update-status.json read only when dir exactly 0750 root-owned and file exactly 0640/nlink1/same-gid. Batch state 0600 with derived-public-key verification. Identity bootstrap refuses peer changes once pinned — center cannot silently re-key the node.

local_checks.invariant: Node self-update installs only checksum-verified release binary with manifest pinned to release redirect, staging dirs re-verified before root action
local_checks.result: HOLDS. update.sh fetches SHA256SUMS from fixed origin with curl proto/tls pinning, requires redirect Location to match ^https://github.com/kejilion/KPanel/releases/download/v\d+.\d+.\d+/SHA256SUMS$ (pinning manifest to one release), checksum hex64, sha256sum verification before version probe; install -o root -g root -m 0755 with rollback. Comparable in class to panel self-update (OCI digest pinning vs asset SHA — same GitHub trust root). Root migration path independently re-hashes staged binary against SHA256SUMS inside staging dir with ownership/mode/symlink checks; templates generation-compared so newer runtimes never downgraded.

surface: agent /v1/backups and recover flow → hostbackup Engine
attack_class: Host-side restore authority and path escape

local_checks.invariant: Engine.Restore applies payloads journal-first with revalidatable identity, O_EXCL copy-only trees, protection against fresh inventory, rollback never deleting data while a new writer survives; Create reads only fixed enumeration
local_checks.result: Boundary holds for this check. Journal before any mutation; previous/next paths verified non-existent; mount-coverage; protected-root and protected-container rejection; destination-writer overlap rejection; noLinkParents/noNestedMounts; copyTree O_EXCL; rollback deletes new writers before data, restores old last; committed flag gates cleanup. Recover validates journal structure strictly. No Go-side shell anywhere in hostbackup (Docker HTTP with PathEscape).

local_checks.invariant: Crafted .kpb part paths cannot escape the payload root AND payload Root.Path values are confined to the data-scope the export producer emits
local_checks.result: Part-path containment holds (parts[0]==data, matching root ID, Clean/ToSlash equality, no backslash/dot-dot, TypeReg/Dir only, volume mounts match). BUT root-scope assumption FAILS: validatePayload checks Root.Path only for absolute-canonical and !excluded(), and excluded() blocks solely panel-owned dirs + /proc,/sys,/dev,/run — host system directories (/etc, /root, /usr, /boot, /var/lib/docker) are accepted as restore roots. Export side never produces such roots (owner(): /home/web→web, /home→apps, else docker); no import-time or restore-time step compares payload roots against destination inventory. A structurally valid payload can swap host system directories — CANDIDATE FILED.

local_checks.invariant: Restore cannot clobber mounted filesystems; restored container mounts pinned to inspected mounts so no stale ID redirects data
local_checks.result: Boundary holds. noNestedMounts enforced before each target swap and inside removeDataTree; destination-container live-bind overlap rejected; declared mounts must be covered by selected modules; nativeMountConfig checked against container inspect-resolved mounts, VolumesFrom deleted. No user-controlled mount target; all originate from validated payload mounts.

local_checks.invariant: protection.go prevents restore from replacing/deleting/impersonating Panel/Agent runtime; no bypass
local_checks.result: Boundary holds for the panel-runtime scope. RuntimeProtection detects Panel/Agent via container name, env destinations, entrypoint/command base names, data/secret mounts; restore causes root-path overlap rejection, protected-name conflict, protected-namespace rejection; import rejects payloads claiming panel identity; excluded() independently hardcodes panel dirs. No bypass — but protection scope is Panel runtime dirs, NOT host system dirs (this gap is the filed candidate's subject).

local_checks.invariant: Panel import and CLI flows share one authenticated Agent service with identical validation; no caller can supply a filesystem path
local_checks.result: Boundary holds. Single Service.ServeHTTP behind bearer-token agent server; module names constrained to record.Modules ∩ {apps,web,docker} before filename joins; IDs ValidID-checked; bodies bounded strict-decoded; restore requires ready import record + matching TargetRevision. CLI is HTTP client of same endpoints with same token. Single-writer enforced by backup.Manager gates + agent backupMutationMu. Directory arguments always internally derived.

local_checks.invariant: Agent socket is root:group 0660 in 0750 dir; token file root+exact-GID exactly-0640 regular non-symlink with SameFile race guard; stale socket refusal cannot replace non-socket path
local_checks.result: Verified directly: ListenUnix absolute path, group required, dir 0750 root:gid, socket 0660 root:gid, removeStaleSocket refuses non-socket paths and live listeners, cleanup SameFile-guarded. PrepareTokenFile rejects non-regular/symlink, requires Uid==0 and exact GID and exactly 0640 perms, LimitReader 4097, length 32-4096 after trim, SameFile between Lstat and opened handle.

local_checks.invariant: Every agent request carries the bearer token compared constant-time against SHA-256 hash; panel reads token fresh from file per client construction; agent requires ≥32-byte token at NewServer
local_checks.result: Verified: authorized() at server.go:495-506 requires Bearer prefix, rejects comma/whitespace-forms, sha256+subtle.ConstantTimeCompare. ServeHTTP gates ALL routes on authorized before dispatch. agentclient attaches Authorization header per request; response bodies capped 8MiB; redirects refused.

local_checks.invariant: Public-scope provider URLs require https with no private/loopback resolved addresses; private scope explicitly confirmed; API key only sent to stored BaseURL; redirects re-validated with auth headers stripped
local_checks.result: Invariant holds. ValidateProviderURL rejects userinfo/query/fragment/CRLF hosts; https for public; isLiteralBlocked + Dial-time ValidateResolvedAddresses reject if ANY resolved address blocked — rebinding closed (dial to addresses[0].IP, fresh client per request so no stale pooled connections). Redirects re-validate scope, cap 3, delete auth headers on cross-origin hops. API key attached only to stored BaseURL+endpoint — no path from message content/attachments/tool calls to the URL.

local_checks.invariant: No non-admin-influenced path selects or changes provider config; attachments bounded/validated without server-side image decode
local_checks.result: Invariant holds. Single-admin model; provider mutation session+CSRF+origin; sessions only SELECT existing provider/model pairs; message POST takes content+attachments validated (≤4 items, 8MiB total, images ≤4MiB via DetectContentType + allowlisted extensions); never decoded server-side (no image.Decode in internal/ai) — no decompression bomb; multipart MaxBytesReader 12MiB with per-file LimitReader.

local_checks.invariant: Compromised catalog cannot install arbitrary content; controls only bounded display metadata
local_checks.result: Held. Origin fixed https://app.kejilion.sh, 6s timeout, 2MiB cap, same-hostname redirects ≤2. Strict schema: source pinned, ≤500 apps, unique IDs/tokens, length bounds. Catalog controls display strings + suggested port + icon slug only; NOT the executed command (fixed kejilion.sh app <selector>), image, or container name.

local_checks.invariant: Privileged exec path = root-owned script + validated selector charset + embedded protocol markers, re-validated at execution
local_checks.result: Held. Selector charset re-validated by appSelectorPattern at both execution points; exec.Command argv never shell string; findKejilionScriptMatching requires root-owned non-world-writable 1KiB-4MiB with embedded KJ_APP_NONINTERACTIVE markers + license; builtin selectors require literal menu case; systemd units fixed argv — no unit content from catalog data.

local_checks.invariant: Third-party app configs are trusted files with fixed-shape assignments
local_checks.result: Held. Lstat /root/apps/<token>.conf: regular, non-symlink, root-owned, ≤256KiB; only literal docker_name/docker_app_service assignments accepted, duplicates rejected, invalid shapes outright error; access-mode files ≤64 bytes direct|domain_only.

local_checks.invariant: Catalog-derived port data flows only as validated suggestion; conflicts detected before install
local_checks.result: Held. DefaultPort bounded 1-65535; inspectInstallPort enumerates Docker bindings and /proc/net listeners, refuses conflicts; HostPort travels only via KJ_APP_PORT fixed env. Panel never composes docker run from catalog fields; container identity from build-time embedded legacy-apps.json.

local_checks.invariant: Icon fetches cannot escape official origin or smuggle content; embedded digest not remotely overridable
local_checks.result: Held. Same scheme/host redirects ≤2, 4s timeout; re-validates token/icon patterns + source path; requires image/webp ≤128KiB with WebP magic + dimension caps; 0600 temp+rename into 0700 non-symlink dir; mergeRemoteCatalog keeps locally pinned Icon and IconSHA256 for known apps — remote cannot swap icon digest anchor.

local_checks.invariant: User-provided names in copy-paste enrollment command cannot break out of single-quoted argument
local_checks.result: UPHELD. shellSingleQuote maps each ' to '\'' (close, escaped quote, reopen); input a' yields 'a'\''' which POSIX-parses as single word a'. Metacharacters inert inside unbroken single-quoted spans; every emitted quote balanced. cleanDisplayText rejects all control characters and caps 80 runes.

local_checks.invariant: No other name flow reaches a shell command string
local_checks.result: UPHELD. Batch command embeds only token (no --name); lightBatchNodeName display-only capped 80 runes; controller names flow only into display records never command strings.

local_checks.invariant: kpl1 enrollment one-time and race-free
local_checks.result: UPHELD. mutationMu serialization; EnrollHost consumes enrollment and adds host under one store lock with rollback on persist failure. nodeID is center-minted wire.ID; second enroll hits ErrPairingCode and duplicate-host check.

local_checks.invariant: kpb1 batch re-enroll cannot steal existing node's reporting key
local_checks.result: UPHELD with documented reliance on attemptID secrecy. Reserve and re-check bind returned reporting key to full identity tuple (kpb1 token + victim 128-bit attemptID + matching name + matching terminal public key). attemptID root-only 0600 node-side, never listed by panel. kpb1 shared batch secret never used as reporting key — each node independent 32-byte key. NodeID center-generated per attempt. Concurrent serializes on mutationMu + store locks. (Structural-improvement note in hardening.)

local_checks.invariant: Light report/file-capability HMAC authenticates exact raw body, method, path, node identity; replay-guarded
local_checks.result:
UPHELD. HMAC-SHA256 over POST
path
nodeID
ts
requestID
sha256(rawBody); signed bytes are exactly the decoded JSON; constant-time compare; ±120s skew; replay guard keyed nodeID:RequestID with distinct namespace; separate rate limits per source and nodeID; pairing token binds origin preventing cross-origin replay.

local_checks.invariant: File relay commands allowlisted at every layer; 512MiB cap enforced at byte-consumption points
local_checks.result: UPHELD. validateFileRelayCommand at command construction in every relay; serveStreamRequest and panelFileRelaySession re-validate. Bounded by bytes: sendBody aborts at offset+count>512MiB; stream upload loop aborts on total>streamMaxUpload or declared length; federatedFileUpload rejects ContentLength>MaxUploadBytes and Agent wraps every upload with MaxBytesReader so chunked -1 declaration cannot bypass. relayRequestHeaders strips anything outside 6-name allowlist.

local_checks.invariant: WebSocket stream authorization binds envelope freshness, node key equality, rate, replays; peer completes only panel-initiated requests
local_checks.result: UPHELD. authorizeFileStream enforces envelope validation, TargetID, CodeID empty, ±120s, GET+path in IK prologue, peer static == node's stored key, rate, replay guard — all under hub mutex shared with revocation cleanup so no stale-auth race. data sockets must match hub-created pending requestID with generation and pointer equality; requestIDs hub-generated randomHex. Upload cap before handler sees EOF; only authenticated streamEnd closes body pipe — truncation cannot publish partial files.

local_checks.invariant: Panel-target file relay executes only constrained Panel file surface with per-peer scope
local_checks.result: UPHELD. handlePanelFileRelayV2 requires Active + ScopeAllowsFiles; Command.RequestID==SessionID identity binding; full validateFileRelayCommand; handler exclusively federatedFileHandler — never general agent proxy or router.

boundary: internal/cluster/service_v2.go#Noise open + replay + peer key check

local_checks.invariant: No v2 route reaches handler without full envelope validation; every path exact-match v2PathAllowed
local_checks.result: UPHELD. validateV2Request (POST-only, envelope shape, TargetID==NodeID, ±120s skew, CodeID only on pair) before any switch arm; pre-dispatched history/file paths run it independently; unknown paths ErrAuthentication. Panel match exact switch. Envelope metadata bound into Noise IK prologue; peer static key equality vs controller.PublicKey enforced.

local_checks.invariant: Light-node and controller namespaces disjoint; cannot impersonate across stores even on ControllerID collision
local_checks.result: UPHELD. Relay handlers first look up light.Host(ControllerID); on hit require IK-responder peer static key == node's stored Noise public key; controllers authenticated against controller.PublicKey — a key cannot satisfy both branches, collision fails closed. IDs both center-side randomHex(16), never caller-chosen.

local_checks.invariant: Revoked controller retains no capability; revocation state machine fails closed
local_checks.result: UPHELD. Every handler requires controllerStateV2Active (commit/revoke allow provisional/revoked); revoke idempotent-only. Retention 10min with GC in cleanupV2Locked run by pairing and 5-min checkpoint ticker. Terminal doubly gated (scope AND state); file peers and stream sockets closed at revoke; lingering PTY unreachable because Output/Input also require Active.

local_checks.invariant: V1 ed25519 signatures unforgeable, non-replayable within window, unambiguous canonical string
local_checks.result:
UPHELD. canonicalRequest over METHOD
EscapedPath
cID
tID
ts
nonce
sha256(empty). All v1 entry points reject RawPath!="" so EscapedPath==Path exact-match before verification — no normalization ambiguity. Nonce 16-byte hex; ±60s window; replay guard retention 5min strictly longer than timestamp span; entries evicted only after expiry/Accept; guard rejects at capacity fail-closed.

local_checks.invariant: Summary-scoped v1 controller relaying through FileRelayV1 cannot reach arbitrary agent paths or smuggle request data
local_checks.result: UPHELD. validFileRelayRequest: method GET/HEAD/POST/PUT, Path in exact constant allowlist, RawQuery ≤48KiB no CRLF/NUL, headers limited to 6-name relay set, BodyLength [-1,512MiB]. federatedFileHandler re-checks FileRelayRequestPath plus per-route strictPanelQuery and method checks; uploads bounded agent-side. No terminal/general-proxy/non-allowlisted route reachable.

local_checks.invariant: Pairing-code consumption and failure burn persisted atomically; every v1 route enforces SummaryScope
local_checks.result: UPHELD. ConsumePairingCode increments Attempts on mismatch, removes at ≥5, persistLocked rolls back on failure. All v1 mutating routes require SummaryScope; only mutations are pair (pairing-code-bearer) and self-revocation (deletes only own record).

local_checks.invariant: Every terminal route enforces terminal scope and owner binding; sessions cannot cross controllers or hosts
local_checks.result: UPHELD. All v2 terminal routes through openTerminalControllerV2 = Active + ScopeAllowsTerminal; summary-only controller fails. Light relay path authenticates by node's Noise key against light store, unavailable to controllers; file stream light-nodes-only; other terminal surfaces session-gated UI. Sessions owner-bound (federation:{controllerID}; manager.lookup enforces owner); output of host A not readable via host B session; light sessions namespaced per nodeID.

local_checks.invariant: Terminal dimensions, input size and relay command expiry bounded
local_checks.result: UPHELD. Rows [1,500]/Columns [1,1000] at all three layers; input 16KiB at handler, lightTerminal.input, decodeTerminalPayload; output truncated 32KiB per federation read; relay commands 2-min TTL within now..now+5min; takeCommand drops expired before delivery.

local_checks.invariant: Container-id path segment charset-constrained; exec lifecycle IDs validated at each hop
local_checks.result: Pass. containerIDPattern pure hex — no path/query smuggling into API URL construction; createFixedExec enforces 64-hex on container ID and validates returned exec ID; startNginxExec/inspectNginxExec re-validate. Panel handler rejects RawPath/RawQuery, session+CSRF, re-checks patterns; AI tool path same patterns. Running commands in admin's own container is the documented feature.

local_checks.invariant: Exec commands single-line bounded, resource-version bound, time-bounded, output redacted and size-bounded
local_checks.result: Pass. validContainerCommand rejects CR/LF/NUL/control; verifyContainerVersion before exec; 20s context; boundedRedactedNginxOutput applies redact.Lines regexes (password/token/secret/api-key/authorization/cookie/bearer/URL-credential/private-key), per-line 16KB cap, line-count cap, total truncation. Raw container output never passes unredacted.

local_checks.invariant: normalizeArchiveEntry rejects absolute, backslash, NUL, dot/dot-dot components, oversize names, .kpanel-* names, Clean-escaping; extraction into .kpanel-extract-* temp renamed no-replace
local_checks.result: Invariant holds. All writes joinVirtual(tempVirtual, name) inside resolveExisting-validated mutationError-checked target; no archive path climbs out (dot-dot rejected pre-Clean); ZipSlip impossible; entries never become symlinks (ZIP ModeSymlink and TAR non-Dir/Reg typeflags rejected BEFORE the selection filter runs); nested archives never auto-extracted.

local_checks.invariant: Selection-based extraction validates every entry; budgets bound declared and actual bytes
local_checks.result: Verified in code not only test: normalizeArchiveEntry + duplicate detection + type/mode checks run BEFORE archiveInclude; unselected entries drained and still counted against budgets. Actual byte accounting via LimitReader(remaining+1) plus written>remaining rejection — ZIP declaring small size but decompressing larger cannot blow past 10GiB/10k entries. boundedZIPDirectory bounds central directory 8MiB, rejects ZIP64 sentinels, verifies offsets, freezes directory bytes. Archive-jobs state restore never trusts stored temp path unless journal-owned; state dir pinned with component walk rejecting symlinks.

local_checks.invariant: Upload filename validation rejects separators/parent names/.kpanel-*; parent resolveExisting-validated; staged as O_EXCL temp atomically renamed; 512MiB cap even without Content-Length
local_checks.result: Invariant holds. Panel strictPanelQuery + octet-stream + ContentLength cap + streamed; agent re-checks all + MaxBytesReader. validateName blocks traversal (path separators rejected after decode); directory walk with full symlink rejection; temp O_EXCL fails on symlink at temp name; overwrite re-locks + re-stats + version-checked rename; failure always Removes temp. Chunked: LimitReader(MaxUploadBytes+1) plus written check enforces cap on actual bytes; remote-download runner independently caps before agent. No cleanup gap found.

local_checks.invariant: resolveExisting/normalizeVirtual reject traversal, separators, NUL, backslash, >4096B, non-absolute; every component Lstat-walked via os.Root with symlink rejection at each level; .kpanel-* internal names blocked; protected roots blocked
local_checks.result: Invariant holds. Double slashes cleaned before walking and comparison (no equivalence bypass). All actual I/O uses rootFS Root-relative ops after the walk, never the absolute host-path string; renameNoReplaceRoot opens parents through the Root. TOCTOU window exists between walk and open, but no panel surface can create a symlink (no os.Symlink in non-test filemanager code; extract rejects symlink entries; O_EXCL temp creation) — declared principal cannot materialize the symlink needed. Unicode: byte-exact matching against ASCII protected list, homoglyph variants do not resolve.

local_checks.invariant: isMutationProtected blocks mutations into protected dirs AND of their ancestors; ReadOnly both directions; new-file destinations validate name and resolve parent cleanly
local_checks.result: Invariant holds. isWithin(protected, virtual) makes chmod on / and /var rejected because KPanel state dirs are protected descendants. Upload/mkdir/rename validate name (no separators, NUL, >255, .kpanel-*, dot-dot) + resolveExisting-walked parent + mutationError on joined target; single-name-only prevents nested creation; trash restore re-validates metadata with RENAME_NOREPLACE; cross-device fallback via .kpanel-copy- temp + no-replace rename.

surface: AI tool calls with host authority

local_checks.invariant: ApprovalMode cannot be influenced by model or message content
local_checks.result: Settled: ApprovalMode only from sessions table; default manual; UpdateSession rejects non-manual/auto; no tool result/model output/message field reaches approval_mode writes.

local_checks.invariant: No write-effect tool is marked ReadOnly (ReadOnly tools execute without approval)
local_checks.result: Settled: enumerated every ReadOnly tool — all dispatch to hostOps.Get read-only routes. All write tools have ReadOnly unset; host_nginx_reload has no ReadOnly flag so cannot slip through the ReadOnly short-circuit.

local_checks.invariant: ApprovalManual mode: every non-ReadOnly tool requires approval before execution
local_checks.result: Settled: runtime forces RequiresApproval=true for manual+non-ReadOnly; every execution path only runs approved or policy-exempt calls; Resume requires matching pending states; DryRun before any approval-state impact.

local_checks.invariant: Approve/reject endpoints authorize acting session user over the run
local_checks.result: Settled: run resolution scoped by user_id in SQL; non-GET requires Origin+CSRF; write tools audit intent before execution with redacted summaries.

local_checks.invariant: host_file_write arguments validated per-tool and re-validated agent-side
local_checks.result: Settled: reason stripped before validation; strict decode; path ≤4096 clean; content ≤64KiB; resourceVersion pattern; aiFileMutable denylist; agent-side filemanager mutationError re-check + existing-file + SameFile race guard + cap. host_file_write auto-approval in auto mode is the documented product decision (docs/ai-workspace.md matches code exactly).

local_checks.invariant: SSE run-event and session endpoints authenticated and bounded
local_checks.result: Settled: session+ownership checks; 20s write deadlines/15s heartbeats; unsubscribe on return; depth bounded (12 model steps/20 tool calls/1MiB assistant bytes/64KiB args/16KiB messages/8MiB attachments).

local_checks.invariant: Archive decode authenticates every byte before use; part extraction cannot escape staging
local_checks.result: Held. scrypt(N=32768) with file-supplied 32-byte salt, KDF params fixed by format; chacha20poly1305-X per 64KiB frame with AAD and monotonic numbering, authenticated final empty frame, total bounded. Read requires first tar entry exactly manifest.json ≤16KiB; part names exactly <module>.payload opened O_EXCL 0600 in private staging (no path interpolation from archive); per-part sha256 re-verified; trailing-zero enforcement. Import handler: MaxBytesReader, exactly two multipart parts, password 10-256 bytes, 2x space preflight.

local_checks.invariant: Restored panel filenames allowlisted; unreachable paths refused
local_checks.result: Held. panelBackupPath accepts only fixed roots (cluster state, cluster-secrets*, desktop-workspace, terminal-commands, notifications), ≤3 components, leaf charset [a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{1,160} excluding dot/dotdot, per-root suffix rules. decodePanelBackup bounds ≤4096 files/8MiB each/32MiB total; re-sanitizes JSON state (pairing codes blanked, non-active hosts dropped, notice channels forced disabled). Rollback re-validates every name plus NoLinkParents on full parent chain; writes via AtomicFile into 0700 PrivateDir with no-symlink checks.

local_checks.invariant: Out-of-place validation opens restored content through real owning services before anything live changes
local_checks.result: Held. Staged copy into private temp dir; requires cluster-state.json + node-identity key; constructs actual cluster/desktop/terminalcommands/notification services over staged tree with NO background workers (no peer contact, no notifications). PruneBackupSecrets requires every credential referenced by an active host present; ValidateBackupReferences re-reads each credential requiring v2 public key match.

local_checks.invariant: Restore authorized only for authenticated admin; malicious archive cannot unauthenticated re-pair panel or resurrect bearer credentials
local_checks.result: Held with one-by-design consequence: apply DOES replace cluster federation state, node identity key, controller records, and admin identity — an attacker-crafted .kpb (with attacker-known password) imported by an admin anchors controller trust to attacker keys. This is the documented admin-restore semantic (import password is the credential); no unauthenticated or CSRF-free path exists; identity payload structurally constrained (exactly one admin user, zero sessions/shares, ClusterShare+SecurityEntrance must be disabled, TOTP shape-checked under backup key). RestoreIdentity revokes all live sessions rather than reactivating tokens; restore carries over existing controller revocations.

local_checks.invariant: Restore transaction durable: intent precedes mutation, interrupted apply rolls back, completed restore never replayed; agent token and bootstrap not in payload
local_checks.result: Held. Intent→pending journal before live change; second intent refused ErrBusy; ApplyPanelRestore snapshots previous state before first write, phased journal, full rollback on mid-apply failure; pending/committed never roll back. Files written = union of previous live names + payload names under DataDir + TOTP/identity — no config files, no agent token (host-side paths outside DataDir), no bootstrap token. Interrupted jobs marked failed at open; Sweep cannot delete in-flight journal.

local_checks.invariant: (pipeline sweep) Build-time kejilion.sh fetch pinned to content; all third-party inputs digest-pinned; no untrusted code with secrets; release-body digest is the built artifact
local_checks.result: Held. Dockerfile ADD pins upstream commit SHA + sha256 checksum; check-managed-script-contract enforces single revision+digest across Dockerfile/docs/image labels; release.yml re-verifies digest of file inside built image. Every uses: reference is 40-hex digest pin with persist-credentials:false; no pull_request_target; ci.yml read-scoped token. Multi-arch push outputs manifest digest; promote requires tag-digest==build-digest and channel-tag-digest==build-digest; draft release sentinel prevents partial publication; render-release-notes emits exact parser format only after equalities. All asserted in supply-chain hardening notes: govulncheck tag-pinned and app-market :latest pulls recorded separately.

surface: cluster notifications settings/discover/test and outbound notification dispatch
attack_class: SSRF and data leakage via notification webhooks

local_checks.invariant: Every outbound destination is a fixed-origin HTTPS webhook chosen by DetectProvider; no free-form URL fetched; no redirect/port escape
local_checks.result: HOLDS. DetectProvider accepts only Telegram token pattern (not a URL), feishu exact path with secret charset, dingtalk exact /robot/send single access_token, wecom exact /cgi-bin/webhook/send single key. Rejects non-https/userinfo/opaque/RawPath/fragment/any port/non-canonical. ValidChannelCredential requires detected==provider so Telegram token never dispatched as robot URL. Proxy nil, TLS>=1.2, redirects never followed, bounded reads. No other outbound HTTP in package — no SSRF/exfil channel.

local_checks.invariant: Test/discover/update require session+Origin+CSRF; test sends never return or log stored credential; snapshots expose only salted fingerprint
local_checks.result: HOLDS. All enter through requireClusterMutation. Audit change payloads record booleans only. Service consumes stored credential internally; snapshots surface TokenFingerprint=sha256 only; error mapping returns fixed code strings never echoing URLs or upstream bodies. Test messages fixed templates. GET read path session-only — correct.

local_checks.invariant: Telegram bot token only in URL path of fixed api.telegram.org; never leaks to non-Telegram URLs, logs, or error text
local_checks.result: HOLDS. token only on api.telegram.org path. RobotClient rejects telegram provider before URL use — token cannot be exfiltrated to feishu/dingtalk hosts. No slog/audit formats the token; errors are typed-code strings, upstream Description discarded.

local_checks.invariant: No semi-trusted principal can inject control characters/newlines/markup into outbound messages; plain text only, no parse mode
local_checks.result: HOLDS. Message interpolates only sanitized fields: host names via safeMessageText (strips all control chars, 240 runes; write-time cleanDisplayText validation prevents newline storage), SSH login fields regex-validated node+center, numeric metrics, fixed-format timestamps. Telegram no parse_mode + disable preview; robot payload text type only — no markdown/HTML rendering on any channel, injected glyphs display literally. Resource data withdrawn never interpolated; cluster peer names validated at store-write and on read.

local_checks.invariant: Notification credentials at rest mode-restricted, symlink-immune, re-validated on read, never leave host except inside scrypt-encrypted backup archive
local_checks.result: HOLDS with design gap in hardening. Credential in own file 0600 in 0700 dir; readRegularFile refuses world/group-readable + symlinks + in-place swap (SameFile); DetectProvider re-run on read. State file contains only TokenFingerprint sha256. Backups include the token filename but payload sealed with scrypt+AEAD. Gap: unlike TOTP secrets (AES-GCM sealed), notification credential is plaintext at 0600 — accepted single-admin choice, weaker than TOTP path, recorded in hardening.

local_checks.invariant: Cluster telemetry only to exact 64-hex token holders, constant time, only while enabled
local_checks.result: Control holds. secureStringEqual = sha256 digests compared with subtle.ConstantTimeCompare; 32 random bytes hex, 256-bit entropy; uniform 404; per-request re-read of store so disable takes effect immediately.

local_checks.invariant: Snapshot exposes no host secrets: no tokens, raw IDs, origins, credentials
local_checks.result: Control holds. publicClusterShareSnapshot exposes telemetry fields only; public host IDs are HMAC-SHA256(share token, hostID) truncated 12 hex bytes; token never included in responses.

local_checks.invariant: Token rotation and share mutation require authenticated session
local_checks.result: Control holds. GET settings requireSession; PUT/POST requireClusterMutation (origin+session+CSRF); rotation effective immediately; caches invalidated on rotation.

local_checks.invariant: Rate limiting not bypassable by address forgery under default deployment
local_checks.result: Fixed 1-min window 120/min keyed by remoteIP with 2048-key cap. remoteIP honors forwarded headers only from trustedProxies (default loopback only); XFF walk right-to-left returns rightmost non-trusted entry. Remote attacker cannot spoof loopback source. Residual: loopback proxy that does not append client address is a config contract, hardening note.

attack_class: Diagnostic job script trust and interactive root terminal input

local_checks.invariant: Diagnostic script discovered only through trusted-marker chain identical in strength to recipe jobs
local_checks.result: HOLDS with shared TOCTOU nuance in hardening. findScript is the same algorithm as findTrustedKejilionScript (same candidates, EvalSymlinks, size window, perm, root owner on Linux, license + KJ markers). Run path fixed argv never shell string. Nuance: Stat-then-ReadFile swap window (recipe twin shares it); exploitation requires root, so no invariant break under current threat models — hardening to unify with SameFile pattern.

local_checks.invariant: checkID never reaches a command position: regex-constrained at every boundary, matched against catalog before job creation, single argv element
local_checks.result: HOLDS. selectorPattern enforced at panel handler, forwarder, AI tool gate, agent collection, service Start, and root RunJob re-read. Start requires ID in merged catalog; parseCatalog re-validates all IDs/categories against same pattern; ID alphabet excludes / and ; and delivered as one argv element. mergeCatalogs native-primary so script items cannot shadow native IDs; native dispatch hardcoded switch with default reject.

local_checks.invariant: Interactive diagnostic input follows shared interactive-job pattern: FIFO 0600, panel 1..16384 no-NUL, service re-check, bounded writes, output capped
local_checks.result: HOLDS and does not deviate. mkfifo 0600; O_NONBLOCK with deadline; panel validates jobIDPattern + size + no-NUL + Origin+session+CSRF via strict allowlist. Service.WriteInput re-validates and requires Interactive/InputOpen/queued-or-running; reads capped 64KiB chunks; log truncated 8MiB; Pdeathsig so broker exit cannot leave stray shell.

local_checks.invariant: Persisted job state re-read validated like webenv gate: ID matches filename, CheckID pattern, 256KiB bound, tampered dropped as not-found, run path re-validates before exec
local_checks.result: HOLDS. readLocked enforces jobIDPattern, size, item.ID==id, selectorPattern; else ErrNotExist. listLocked drops unparseable; load ignores failures. Root RunJob re-checks selector and re-derives workspace path with Dir equality. BootID fences stale running jobs cross-boot. Minor hardening: json.Unmarshal without DisallowUnknownFields inconsistent with the rest — fields reaching execution re-checked anyway.

local_checks.invariant: Native diagnostics fixed-endpoint policy: compile-time constant URLs, only dynamic input IPv4 re-validated by net.ParseIP
local_checks.result: HOLDS. All probe URLs constants; IPing interpolates only public IP (url.Values encoded / PathEscape) onto fixed endpoints, requires To4(); publicIP from locally-parsed Cloudflare trace response. Bodies size-capped; summary metrics whitespace-collapsed and clamped. No admin-reachable setting alters endpoints.

local_checks.invariant: URL validation permits only http/https LDH hostnames, no userinfo/fragment/backslash/control; dialer resolves then dials validated IP with publicAddress filtering; redirects re-validated, https→http refused, ≤5 hops, headers stripped
local_checks.result: Invariant holds. validHostname rejects all-numeric hosts; hex/octal dotted forms pass LDH but resolve() filter applies to whatever the resolver returns (fail-closed). IPv6 zones rejected; IPv4-mapped Unmap'd; NAT64/Teredo/2002 in reservedPrefixes. DNS rebinding prevented (connection to validated IP, not hostname; Host/SNI original for TLS). maxDialAddresses truncation AFTER resolve() validated every record. Redirect policy per hop. Name never derived from URL path; target directory canonical absolute through agent entry endpoint walk; overwrite always false + uniqueFileTransferName.

local_checks.invariant: Share metadata served only for valid unexpired token; no host path revealed
local_checks.result: Control holds. Token 43-char base64url/32 bytes; FileShareByToken constant-time compare of sha256(token) + expiry; 256-bit entropy; uniform 404; second store lookup with ID comparison closes delete-replay race; JSON view exposes only Name/MIME/Size/ExpiresAt.

local_checks.invariant: Share content streamed only for valid share; text/html never inline; fixed agent parameters
local_checks.result: Control holds. Query exactly absent or download=1; 2-slot stream gate; deadline clamped to share expiry; registered stream cancellation on delete; If-Match from stored state; only Range-family headers forwarded; CSP with sandbox; inline only for image/* safe list, text/html forced octet-stream attachment.

local_checks.invariant: Validation-limited requests cannot enumerate or DoS agent fingerprinting
local_checks.result: Covered. allowFileShareValidation rejects before OpenStream; per-path and global budgets 512 units/min; sizes from stored share state not client input.

local_checks.invariant: Anonymous ticket holder can download only the exact bound path, cannot guess/enumerate tickets, cannot alter agent request at redemption, expired tickets rejected
local_checks.result: Control holds. Redemption files.go:307-342: GET/HEAD only, RawQuery rejected, token 43-char base64url decoding to 32 bytes keyed as sha256(decoded); lookup deletes expired entries; issuance session+origin+CSRF with canonical absolute path; token crypto/rand 32 bytes collision-checked, TTL 5min, cap 128; agent request rebuilt server-side from stored state; only Range/If-None-Match/If-Modified-Since/If-Range forwarded (not authz inputs); 256-bit entropy, wrong guess yields uniform 404.

local_checks.invariant: Download tickets single-use vs reusability within TTL (recon lead)
local_checks.result: Recon claim factually accurate but intended double-submit semantics: files_test.go:340-422 performs ranged GET then HEAD on the SAME ticket (resume support). Replay window bounded to 5 min, fixed path only, TTL enforced every lookup (files_test.go:424-434). Not a boundary violation; hardening note.

local_checks.invariant: Login rate-limit accounting uses both ip and account keys and cannot be raced
local_checks.result: Covered. reserveLogin checks store failed counts + in-memory pending for ip and account keys (10x multiplier) under loginMu before verification; keys normalized identically in reserve and record (trim/lowercase/truncate); counter reset requires valid credential; IP randomization requires trusted-proxy misconfiguration (account key still applies).

local_checks.invariant: Unknown-user and wrong-password paths structurally indistinguishable
local_checks.result: Covered. Unknown user substitutes same dummyHash (DefaultArgon2idParams); both paths exactly one Argon2id Verify with identical parameters; inputInvalid branch rewrites to dummy preserving single-verify cost; Argon2id Verify constant-time; both return ErrInvalidCredentials. Timing parity structural (wall-clock not measured — noted in unresolved).

local_checks.invariant: TOTP second factor cannot be skipped; valid code cannot replay across concurrent logins
local_checks.result: Covered. secondFactor required whenever TOTPSecret set; only password+2FA or local authority clears secret; ConsumeUserTOTPStep under store mutex requires step > TOTPLastUsedStep so concurrent same-step serializes and second fails; recovery codes single-use (hash removed under mutex); failed codes record both keys; empty-secondFactor early return records no failure but cannot succeed.

local_checks.invariant: Login input bounds and concurrency enforced
local_checks.result: Covered. Password 1-256 bytes / username ≤64 pre-hash; hashSlots non-blocking semaphore (immediate RateLimitError when saturated); decodeJSON strict single-JSON; checkOrigin before credential work; Argon2id parameter ranges bounded.

unresolved_notes: Wall-clock equivalence of dummy-hash vs real-hash path is structurally established (same single Verify, same params) but not measured; a bounded local timing-regression test over N runs would settle it.

local_checks.invariant: Agent proxy handles only GET with session, maps only exact allowlisted public paths to exact agent paths, rejects RawPath tricks and unknown paths
local_checks.result: Verified: handleAgentProxy requires requireSession, rejects RawPath for system/logs paths and RawQuery for public resources, allowedAgentPath is an exact-match map of ~40 GET routes plus regex-validated docker container logs/stats paths with containerIDPattern; unmapped GET yields route_not_found. Server_test.go:778-894 asserts malformed IDs, extra segments, dot-dot and case tricks rejected (h-wild independently verified the preamble).

local_checks.invariant: CSRF double-submit constant-time and triple-bound
local_checks.result: Covered. header==cookie (secureStringEqual) AND hashSecret(header)==session.CSRFHash; cookie tossing yields at most header==cookie but never the session-bound hash (256-bit preimage barrier); empty fails both; all write endpoints gate on this.

local_checks.invariant: No realistic cross-site request passes origin validation; PublicURL-empty fallback fail-closed for browsers
local_checks.result: Covered. With Origin present: compared against PublicURL/validated IP origin/trusted-proxy origin/connection-derived scheme://host; 'null' cannot match. Origin absent + PublicURL set → rejected. Both absent → Sec-Fetch-Site consulted, all cross-site/same-site values rejected; only neither-header requests accepted which modern browsers do not produce for cross-site POSTs; any such legacy request still faces CSRF triple binding + SameSite=Strict. checkHost no-op only when PublicURL empty; nothing in auth flow trusts Host beyond deriving expected origin compared against attacker-controlled Origin; CORP+CSP set on every response.

local_checks.invariant: Every session-authenticated mutating route enforces both checkCSRF and checkOrigin
local_checks.result: Covered with one hardening note. Enumerated all handle* dispatch paths; both checks on all mutating routes via direct code or requireClusterMutation. Single exception: POST /api/v1/files/entries (batch file-listing read) has session+CSRF but not checkOrigin — CSRF triple binding makes cross-site exploitation infeasible; recorded as hardening for uniformity.

unresolved_notes: Origin-empty/Sec-Fetch-absent branch behavior on pre-2020 embedded browser engines cannot be established from source; residual exposure bounded by CSRF session-hash binding + SameSite=Strict; confirming needs browser-matrix deployment test.

local_checks.invariant: Two concurrent bootstraps cannot both create initial admin
local_checks.result: Covered. bootstrapMu held for entire operation; second caller observes IsInitialized true. CreateInitialAdmin re-checks under store write mutex returning ErrAlreadyInitialized. Recovery flows local-only (RecoverPassword not HTTP; reset-password CLI fails when store locked by running panel).

local_checks.invariant: Bootstrap token constant-time, fails closed, consumed
local_checks.result: Covered. Token 256 bits, 0600 O_EXCL fsync; removed once initialized; read fresh each call, secureEqual compare; missing file + uninitialized store = ErrBootstrapUnavailable (fail closed); wrong token returns before Argon2id work (no amplification); consumed after success; handler checkOrigin, never logs token.

local_checks.invariant: Bootstrap identity meets policy; session is normal session
local_checks.result: Covered. Username regex + password 12-256 bytes validated before hashing; Role admin; standard session; all subsequent boundaries apply; handler checkOrigin; 201 + cookies only on success.

local_checks.result: Clean — no hardcoded password/secret/apikey/token literals; TS hits are test files with dummy values.

Enroll/report endpoints read no panel state, failures route to audit+writeClusterError — no state oracle.

local_checks.result: Verified — allowed*Path shared with browser routes plus revalidation; host_file_write bounded 4KiB path/64KiB content/resourceVersion/mutable-path check; read tools fixed path table; ai.tool.* audited before hostOps calls.

attack_class: System action injection into root commands and host config files

local_checks.invariant: Free-text MountPoint/Filesystem never reach mount/mkfs as command text; validated at Panel and Agent, re-validated against fresh privileged snapshot, transported as argv only (MountPoint hex-encoded, Filesystem enum, device by validated major:minor)
local_checks.result: Boundary holds. validateDiskMountPoint (≤4096, no controls, abs, Clean-equality); Filesystem enum ext4/xfs/ntfs/vfat; action-specific field allowlist with duplicate rejection. Agent re-runs contract validation + fresh root-only inspect envelope + validateDiskMountDestination (protected-path refusal, occupied reservation, active-mount via /proc/self/mountinfo, real non-symlink empty dir). Record persistence re-validated on read; RunDiskJob re-verifies. Exec sink: argv with hex.EncodeToString(MountPoint) removing every metacharacter possibility; scripts content-verified root-owned.

local_checks.invariant: Swap flow never accepts a path from the web request; swapfile path is manager config; size validated ≥0 at Panel, Agent, CLI; fixed paths with integer sizes as argv
local_checks.result: Boundary holds. Panel validates SwapSizeMiB ≥0; agent revalidates; swap-run root-only flag-based with panel-configured paths. applySwap uses fixed primary/legacy paths only (fallocate/mkswap/swapoff/swapon with strconv sizes); fstab rewritten via writeAtomic to fixed /etc/fstab. No request field selects any path. Missing upper bound on size → hardening note.

local_checks.invariant: Every other systemmanage writer entry point consumes fixed command lists or injection-proof scalars as argv to trusted protocols or fixed system tools
local_checks.result: Boundary holds for all listed entry points. Firewall IP/CIDR normalized via net.ParseIP/ParseCIDR; country codes ^[A-Z]{2}$; interface regex; cron command single-line ≤2048 via --command-stdin. System tuning enum IDs. Traffic-shutdown strconv of contract-bounded numbers. SSH defense fixed modes + netip. Account management username regex with $-suffix rejected, enums, secrets via --secret-stdin. Reboot validRebootRequest both sides + hardcoded trusted /sbin/reboot with owner+mode checks. Maintenance fixed package-manager command lists with pacman output regex-validated. No raw user string reaches any exec as command text.

local_checks.invariant: DNS server addresses net.ParseIP'd and re-emitted canonical as argv to trusted script; resolv.conf symlink handling; writeAtomic to fixed paths
local_checks.result: Boundary holds. setDNS 1-4 servers per-family caps, unspecified/multicast rejected, canonical ip.String() argv to content-verified trusted script. dnsBackupPath EvalSymlinks + regular-file refusal. Panel-side ParseIP-only is revalidated strictly at agent. No user string written into resolv.conf by Go code.

local_checks.result: Boundary holds. PID>0, StartTimeTicks>0, signal enum, reflect.DeepEqual confinement both sides. /proc/PID/stat start-time match before syscall.Kill. PID only in strconv for file path read; no argv or shell.

local_checks.invariant: Atomic config writes target only config-derived fixed paths; no writeAtomic call site passes a request-derived path
local_checks.result: Boundary holds. writeAtomic Lstat-refuses non-regular/symlink, temp+sync+rename. All call sites fixed joins of config roots; every user-influenced payload first validated (hostname labels, timezone confined zoneinfo, fixed renderers). No request field selects a write path.

local_checks.invariant: Random public terminal session IDs have real entropy
local_checks.result: Settled: crypto/rand 32 bytes hex (256-bit) both panel and agent side.

local_checks.invariant: Ownership enforced on every operation via single strict parse path
local_checks.result: Settled: exact-two-segment routing; UserID check under terminalMu; action switch defaults 404 — no fall-through. Non-GET requires Origin+CSRF; input base64 1..16KiB; output query exactly offset+wait ≤1000ms.

local_checks.invariant: Concurrent opens cannot exceed 16 total / 4 per user
local_checks.result: Settled: reserveTerminalOpen counts live+in-flight under terminalMu before backend open; release on every exit path; prune-before-reserve.

local_checks.invariant: Panel terminal sessions do not outlive auth revocation in a reusable way
local_checks.result: Settled: logout/password-change do not purge terminalSessions but every operation requires requireSession first — revoked token cannot issue any operation; residual root shell is idle-reaper bounded (30min agent/35min panel/8h cap), not a takeover path.

local_checks.invariant: UpdatedAt keepalive cannot keep session alive anonymously
local_checks.result: Settled: refresh only for owning session user under authentication; owner polling extends up to 8h lifetime cap — owner's own interaction.

local_checks.invariant: TOTP enrollment cannot start or confirm without current password
local_checks.result: Covered. StartTOTPEnrollment calls verifyCurrentPassword (Argon2id + per-user reauth rate limit); ConfirmTOTPEnrollment requires enrollment ID randomToken(18) 144 bits returned only to password-verified caller; secureEqual + expiry + global cap 8; session-cookie thief without password can neither start nor confirm. All three handlers enforce session+CSRF+Origin.

local_checks.invariant: Recovery codes single-use even under concurrency
local_checks.result: Covered. 10 random 10-byte codes persisted only as domain-separated SHA-256 hashes; ConsumeUserRecoveryCode removes matched hash atomically with rollback; repeated use returns ErrNotFound → ErrInvalidSecondFactor; Replace swaps set and revokes sessions.

local_checks.invariant: Step-consumption race closed
local_checks.result: Covered. matchTOTPStep accepts offsets {0,-1,+1} with constant-time compare; ConsumeUserTOTPStep wholly under store write mutex rejecting step ≤ TOTPLastUsedStep with secret-unchanged check; serialization means second consumer of identical step always fails; Enable rejects existing secret (ErrConflict) and revokes sessions in same transition.

local_checks.invariant: Disable-TOTP and recovery rotation require password plus live second factor
local_checks.result: Covered. Both call verifyCurrentPassword then verifyAndConsumeSecondFactor; all TOTP transitions revoke sessions atomically; handlers clear cookies; audit intent before mutation and success after; audit failure fails closed 503 before store mutation.

local_checks.invariant: Installed image reference is the immutable digest observed on the official GitHub release body; only that digest reaches the privileged pull path
local_checks.result: Held. Digest anchored to exact labelled line; FindAllStringSubmatch(body,2) rejects unless exactly one match; stable channel rejects draft/prerelease; validateReleaseIdentity pins tag and html_url to official GitHub. Payload ≤1MiB; redirects refused; default TLS. Attacker model (TLS break or upstream compromise) maps to documented trust root.

local_checks.result: Held end-to-end. KJ_KPANEL_TARGET_IMAGE=docker.io/kjlion/kejilion-panel@sha256:<digest> env into fixed inline bash script; kpanel.conf re-validates ^pattern$, docker pull on digest-pinned reference, compose image line with digest, automatic_target_ready re-reads compose for exact digest and compares image IDs/labels/versions. local_checks.result: Held. Digest never re-fetched at install; edited release body leaves install pinned to previously-observed immutable digest — stale-but-pinned is safe. Release notes bounded, display-only, never reach command line or privileged env.

local_checks.invariant: Lower-privilege host process cannot inject or tamper candidate, transaction, or lifecycle script
local_checks.result: Held. State Lstat: regular, non-symlink, Uid==0, perm 0077==0, ≤64KiB, DisallowUnknownFields, cross-checks. ensurePrivateDirectory 0700. Shell side independently validates storage root 0700. Executor paths canonical absolute + trustedRegularFile (regular, non-symlink, no group/world write, Uid 0) for script/agent/lifecycle config; fixedEnvironment PATH pinned.

local_checks.invariant: Interrupted installs recover to previous version/data; cannot wedge or replay
local_checks.result: Held. Recover runs before policy evaluation; lifecycle flock enforced; completion confirmed via digest+compose-line+image-ID+versions or rollback with sha256-verified snapshot; reconcileInterrupted marks succeeded only if installed version covers candidate; CancelQueuedInstall version+digest matched.

local_checks.invariant: Icon fetches pinned to 127.0.0.1:80/443 regardless of URL host; redirects never followed; linked icon hrefs must be same-host with default ports; bodies size/format-bounded without full decode
local_checks.result: Invariant holds. DialContext maps EVERY dial through localSiteIconDialAddress (ports 80/443 only, host discarded); CheckRedirect ErrUseLastResponse (no following). Allowlist from nginx site discovery (admin-writable only); resolveSiteIconURL rejects different-host/port/scheme/userinfo/oversize; fetchBytes caps 256KiB; validateSiteIcon sniffs + parses only headers (DecodeConfig dimension caps, ICO directory validation, WebP container header) — no full decode, no decompression bomb.

local_checks.invariant: Desktop shortcut icon upload authenticated, size-capped, content-type restricted, fully decoded with dimension bounds before persistence
local_checks.result: Invariant holds. Session+CSRF for PUT/DELETE; mime png/jpeg/webp; ContentLength + MaxBytesReader 256KiB (chunked capped); validateIcon full decode for PNG/JPEG/WebP with dimension and pixel caps + quota accounting for replaced icon; 0700 dir atomic temp write; readIcon re-rejects non-regular/symlink.

local_checks.invariant: Every value interpolated into generated nginx conf is charset-validated and cannot introduce directive syntax or path separators
local_checks.result: Pass. normalizeFQDN restricts to lowercase [a-z0-9-] labels (empty labels rejected so a..b and traversal via /,:,@,*,[ impossible); domain→path construction cannot escape webRoot. spec.Upstream built only by normalizeUpstream (http/https, no userinfo/path/query, LDH host or routable IP, port range, IPv6 re-bracketed); renderManagedConfig re-parses the normalized string so proxy_pass target, proxy_set_header Host, proxy_ssl_name inherit the charset. Load-balance entries via normalizeUpstreams; upstream block name = kp_+sha256 hex. RedirectCode enum; RedirectTarget normalized FQDN origin; phpVersion enum. Default index/PHP interpolate domain into HTML unescaped but FQDN charset contains no HTML metacharacters. Atomic rename then nginx -t before reload with rollback. No invariant disagreement.

local_checks.invariant: Custom certificate material and HTTP-port site addresses cannot introduce shell/env/path injection
local_checks.result: Pass. PEMs parse-validated; written only to {stateDir}/{32-hex-jobID}.pem via O_EXCL 0600; passed via env with paths derived from regex-validated job ID not domain; sanitizeSiteCommandEnvironment strips those names from inherited env. Site address parsing permits IPv4:port with same LDH grammar; port as int via strconv in argv only.

local_checks.invariant: Recipe/web/wordpress/proxy/template/redirect/delete job commands argv-only; every argv element and env value from validated fields; persisted job state re-validated before root /bin/bash execution
local_checks.result: Pass. Invocation builders build []string argv and fixed-name env vars from normalizeScriptDomain-validated domains (no =, NUL, whitespace — no env smuggling), validated proxy host/port, https-only FQDN redirect target, map-fixed selectors. Execution exec.CommandContext(/bin/bash, script, args...) — no shell string. Persisted replay path re-derives entire invocation through same normalizers — tampered state cannot inject. deleteWithScript requires domain==existing site's primaryDomain; secrets travel via 0600 files referenced by env, never argv.

local_checks.invariant: Trusted kejilion.sh resolution applies identical trust checks to every candidate including PATH lookup
local_checks.result: Pass with hardening notes. PATH result enters the SAME loop: EvalSymlinks, Stat regular/size/perm, Uid==0, content license+tokens. Agent systemd unit sets no PATH (compiled-in default root-owned dirs). Planted file must be root-owned and non-writable. Residual TOCTOU between Stat and ReadFile + unpinned PATH candidate set recorded as hardening — neither reachable without near-root directory write access.

local_checks.invariant: Session counts, buffers, output and input sizes stay bounded
local_checks.result: Settled: admission under m.mu across spawn; Output ≤64KiB with offset validation; Input ≤16KiB; ring buffer 1MiB trimming → 16 sessions cap ~16MiB total; fixed 32KiB read buffer.

local_checks.invariant: Orphaned sessions without polling reaped
local_checks.result: Settled: 1-minute reap loop; idle ≥30min or age ≥8h closed; finished deleted 5min after close; notify-channel backpressure with ≤1500ms waits; no unbounded queue.

local_checks.invariant: RuntimeMaxSec 8h bounds transient shell lifetime
local_checks.result: Settled: 8h cap + PartOf/After parent; unsetting requires interactive root command in the shell itself — owner exercising own root authority, not panel-boundary bypass.

local_checks.invariant: LDNMP job arguments closed enum at both Start and RunJob; job-derived paths constrained by job-id charset; Cloudflare secrets only via 0600 file in env, never argv
local_checks.result: Pass. validateAction builds fixed-shape args from literal sets; Start persists via jobIDPattern ^[a-f0-9]{32}$ hex-only (no path escape); RunJob requires euid 0, re-validates id and stateDir, re-reads arguments.json and re-runs storedArgumentsAllowed — both ends validated, mismatch fails closed. Secrets only for the two cloudflare ops, length-capped, NUL/CR/LF-rejected, 0600 file, KJ_LDNMP_SECRET_FILE env; argv exactly [web env <validated args>]. trustedScript fixed absolute candidates with full trust checks.

local_checks.invariant: AI provider output, streamed deltas, and tool-result-derived content rendered into DOM must never become executable HTML
local_checks.result: Held by two independent layers. markdown-it 15.0.0 with html:false emits raw HTML as escaped text; linkify produces only http/https/ftp autolinks; validateLink blocks javascript:/vbscript:/file:/data: (except data:image safe set). Fence override delegates to original fence renderer (escaped); copyCode writes textContent to clipboard only. DOMPurify 3.4.14 (package-lock) sanitize with html profile strips svg/mathml namespaces, script, on* handlers; FORBID_TAGS style/iframe/form; 3.4.14 postdates all published sanitizer escapes through the 3.2.4 mstyle fix. Tool-call arguments render as escaped pre interpolations. Test asserts img-onerror and script neutralized.

local_checks.invariant: localStorage values structurally bounded; never reach HTML, URL-scheme, or server-side path-traversal context
local_checks.result: Held. readSiteNames caps 16000 chars, object-only, ids≤128, names sliced to 48, flows only into Vue-escaped interpolation and server-side labels re-validated by workspace.go (validSiteKey). Wallpaper key is allowlist of 5 fixed ids. Upload location via normalizedHostDirectory (absolute, ≤4096, no dot-dot segments else fixed default); flows into upload query params — traversal rejected before use; worst tampered value selects different legitimate directory on same host (self-inflicted).

local_checks.invariant: Locale, theme-color, view-state strings from localStorage resolve through fixed allowlists; never into dynamic imports or style injection
local_checks.result: Held. Locale only literal set zh-CN/zh-TW/en-US; non-zh maps to statically imported en-US messages — no dynamic import specifier from storage. Theme colors length-capped, allowlisted keys, exact version, normalizeHexColor #rgb/#rrggbb only. Remaining localStorage uses are enum/ID comparisons for display only.

local_checks.invariant: v-html sink receives only build-time constant SVG bytes; :src only build-time constant image
local_checks.result: Held. icons record contains only hardcoded keys mapping to cleanBrandSvg()-processed build-time simple-icons 16.27.1 SVG imports plus one hardcoded PNG import; hasOwnProperty.call on props.distro with linuxMark fallback means __proto__/constructor/unicode distro strings fall back to fixed mark; distro originates from detectOperatingSystemIdentity returning only fixed record keys. Sink unreachable for attacker content.

surface: cluster host panel links and navigation

local_checks.invariant: Cluster host navigation URLs are http(s) origins validated at enrollment and re-validated on every persisted-state load; entrance path constrained to safe segment
local_checks.result: Held. host.origin validated at pair time (NormalizeOrigin https-only; NormalizeV2Origin https or http+IP-literal) and re-validated on every persisted-state load (validatePersistedState, validateHostRecordV2) — hosts restored from backup or crafted DB cannot carry non-http(s) origin into href/window.open. securityEntrancePath validated client (^[a-z0-9] pattern) and server (validSecurityEntrancePath) on every federation summary sync. clusterHostPanelURL returns bare validated origin when any check fails.

local_checks.invariant: All externally-directed navigation uses validated http(s) targets with noopener isolation; no javascript:/data: target possible
local_checks.result: Held across every caller. href anchor only for https origins; e2e_http hosts go through confirm dialog + window.open noopener,noreferrer. shareURL is server-generated prefix+64-hex. FilesView re-parses URL, rejects non-http(s), strips search/hash. DesktopView entry.url from server-validated workspace URLs. terminalLinks.openTerminalURL allowlists http/https then noopener,noreferrer — xterm WebLinksAddon routes every link through it so URLs printed by compromised host terminal output cannot become javascript: navigation. Every target=_blank carries noopener noreferrer. No scheme composed from host-controlled data.
